title: He Walked Into A Gangster's House Alone . . . Big Mistake (Episode 3)
caption:
He walked into a gangster's house alone to buy his friends time... then the police walked away 😳 Weak Hero Class 1, episode 3. Follow for episode 4!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #movierecap #recap #spoilerroom #fyp
comment: Was Max brave or just reckless to walk in alone? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: Max walks alone into a gangster's house, and the next thing we see is him *knocked out* on the floor.
To see how it got here, go back three *days*.
In a smoky den, the gangster Rex growls at his boys. Who *did* this?

segments.text: Payback will be ten times worse.

segments.say: But Rex doesn't want revenge for free. Let's make some *money*, he smirks.
Meanwhile, Sam and his friends are at a pool hall. Max brags, watch how the master does *it*.
But Sam doesn't miss. He treats the table like a math *problem*.
Max bets the loser buys Chinese food. Sam wins *anyway*.
Then he says he has to study, and walks away *alone*.
Later, on a rainy night, Sam meets a girl with no *umbrella*.
Walk me home, she says. Because you have an umbrella, and I *don't*.
Then she drags him to a spicy tteokbokki place. I bet you have no *friends*, she says.
She saves his number as *Asshole*. Rude, she says. Totally my *type*.
Meanwhile, we see how Rex really works. A boy who owes him can't pay. You have three days, or I burn your house *down*.
At school, Victor shows up with fake tears. Please help me, he begs. Tell them the fentanyl wasn't *mine*.
Bobby turns to Sam. Should we just give a statement? It's no big *deal*.
But instead, the three boys end up in a dark parking *garage*.
There, Rex steps out of the shadows with his whole crew. Gentlemen, nice to *meet* you.
He points at a boy in a cast. Because of you, he's badly hurt. Bring fifteen million won in three *days*.
Sam stays calm. Do you have any *proof*? he asks.

segments.text: I kill people for money. I maim people too.

segments.say: Rex only smiles. Three days. Or you'll have to borrow it from *me*.
Max says the gang doesn't scare him. But then Rex's men start to *follow* them.
That night, Max calls Amy, a girl who works for Rex. Let's *meet up*.
Be careful with him, she says. He has real *gangsters* behind him.
Give him the money, even if it's only half. Or you'll end up like *us*.
At home, Bobby stares at his dad's gold *watch*.
Three days later, he walks into school with fifteen million won. I sold my dad's watch, he says. He was going to give it to me *anyway*.
Max can't believe it. Just call the police, he says. But Bobby says Rex warned him that won't *help*.
Meanwhile, Amy shows Max how Rex's gambling site *works*. Free Money. New players get fifty thousand won for *free*.
The first rounds, you always win. Then you lose it *all*.
That's when Rex offers a loan. And he takes whatever the kid can put up. Even his mom's *car*.
Then he forces the runaway kids to deal drugs, so they can never *leave*.
The ledger, the contracts and the drugs are all hidden at Rex's place. Sam says, we need to take the police *there*.
But Max has another plan. Let me go there before you guys, he says. I'll buy some *time*.
Bobby says, you can't go alone. Max grins. Don't you know I'm the boss at this *school*?
Max walks off alone. At the school gate, Rex is already *waiting*.
Max leans in. Forget the money. About your gambling site, with a few *tweaks* you'd make way more.

segments.text: That could easily turn the school into a gambling den.

segments.say: Rex bursts out laughing. This guy has some *ambition*!
Okay, get in the car, Rex says. And Max climbs in as the *newbie*.
Behind them, Amy gives Sam the address. A house with a blue *door*.
Sam sends one message to Max's watch. If the address is right, text anything *back*.
In a taxi, Bobby panics. If I'd paid him, it'd be over now. Why did you let Max go *alone*?
At the school gate, another runaway catches Amy. What are you *doing*? Trying to send Rex to *jail*, she says.
We can't keep living like this, she tells him. And he finally lets them *go*.
Max rides to the address in Rex's car, with his watch call *open*.

segments.text: What a lovely house. A blue door.

segments.say: Inside, Rex demands his phone. Max refuses. I take personal information very *seriously*, he says.
Rex explodes, lunges, and Max goes down *hard*.
Then a message lights up. Coming with the police. And Rex goes *cold*.
Meanwhile, Bobby reaches the blue door alone, with the *money*.

segments.text: I want to pay you. Let my friend go, and it's yours.

segments.say: Rex smiles. Come *here*. And Bobby is pulled inside.
Sam arrives with two police officers. But they stop at the *door*.
No warrant, the officer says. A few photos won't *do* anything. And the police walk *away*.
So Sam does what the police won't. He sneaks into the *house*.
Inside, it's dark and empty. Then he spots *blood* on the floor.
Sam calls Amy. Where's the safe? In a room for stolen *goods*, she says.
Then he tries Max's phone. The number you have called cannot be *reached*.
Because Max is out cold in a car, with Bobby beside *him*.
And Sam is alone in a gangster's house, with no one *coming*.
